response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT si.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate;

assumptions.assumption: SUM ignores missing file sizes and durations independently; a group with zero total duration has an undefined rate and is excluded from the benchmark and final averages.
